Plants of the World Online account: Alternanthera pubiflora (Benth.) Kuntze.

The native range of this species is Mexico (Veracruz) to Chile. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome. It is used to treat infection and unspecified medicinal disorders and as a medicine.
